title: Rwiyo rweMakomo paMadekwana
intro: Teererai sezvo mipata ichidzokorora rumbidzo pamwe chete nemuranda akasarudzwa waAllah. Inzwi rine chipo cherwiyo, kutonga kunotsvakwa nevanokakavadzana vari mukamuri, uye simbi yakanyoroveswa nemurairo waMwari yakamirira kuwanikwa. Ndeupi munhu wekunamata uye mutemo wakarurama anotaura kuburikidza nezviratidzo izvi?
clues: Ndakakomborerwa naAllah nerupo uye nenzwi rakanaka rekurumbidza.
Ndakadzidziswa naAllah kunzwisisa mutauro wekutonga kwakarurama pakati pevanokakavadzana.
Ndakatarisana nemhare hofori ine simba muhondo uye nekuda kwaMwari ndakavakunda.
Ndakapihwa uchenjeri, simba uye rugwaro rwemapisarema rwakazarurwa kubva kuna Allah.
Ndakabatsirwa nemakomo neshiri mukukudza Allah pamwe chete neni manheru uye pakubuda kwezuva.
Ndakadzidziswa naAllah kugadzira majasi esimbi akapfava kwandiri.
